bears.name: Chicago Bears
bears.summary: The Chicago Bears are gearing up for Monday Night Football against the Seattle Seahawks, with newly acquired All-Pro defensive tackle Jeffery Simmons, obtained from the Tennessee Titans in a blockbuster trade for 2027 and 2028 first-round picks plus a 2027 fourth-round pick , poised to make his team debut. Adding to the team's momentum, Wu-Tang Clan is set to headline the Thanksgiving halftime show for the Bears-Lions game at Ford Field , while Chicago also continues exploring additional trade options, including a possible reunion with edge rusher Khalil Mack.

lions.name: Detroit Lions
lions.summary: The Detroit Lions defeated the Minnesota Vikings 19-15 at Ford Field, moving to 5-2 and climbing toward the top of the NFC playoff picture, though the win was overshadowed by a scary injury to linebacker Jack Campbell. Campbell remained hospitalized on Monday as team officials hinted that he was recovering from the injury, with the team saying "preliminary indications are positive" and that he "continues to rest and recover at a local hospital."

packers.name: Green Bay Packers
packers.summary: The Green Bay Packers (5-3) are dealing with off-field concerns as the NFL announced it will review allegations from other women regarding previous incidents involving running back Josh Jacobs. Other women contacted police about previous incidents with Packers' Josh Jacobs; NFL will review allegations On a brighter note, the team also received positive injury news as Packers and Micah Parsons (knee) are targeting a Thanksgiving Eve return against the Rams .

vikings.name: Minnesota Vikings
vikings.summary: The Minnesota Vikings suffered their first loss of the season, falling 19-15 to the Detroit Lions despite Kyler Murray's two-point-conversion pass locating a wide-open Addison for a 15-12 lead and his 8-yard TD pass to Hockenson giving Vikings a 13-12 lead . The result has sparked a potential quarterback controversy, with reports noting Kyler Murray is struggling and the Vikings are in a difficult position, with options that aren't guaranteed to dig Minnesota's offense out of the rut it's been stuck in since letting Sam Darnold and Jones leave .
